evidence.evidence_text: Based on recent interpretability theories of LMs, we reconceptualize the non-parametric memory represented by kNN-LM as a learnable Mixture-of-Neighbors Induction Memory (MoNIM), which synergizes the induction capabilities of attention heads with the memorization strength of feed-forward networks (FFN).
By integrating into the model’s information flow, MoNIM functions as an FFN-like bypass layer within the Transformer architecture, enabling effective learning of new knowledge.
